name: NordicEPOD
industry_role: Manufacturer of standardised prefabricated data-centre power modules (EPODs: UPS, switchgear, distribution, cooling and controls, up to 2 MW each)
description: Former CTS Nordics subsidiary that received a strategic investment from Eaton and CTS Nordics in 2024 and opened a 12,000 m2 factory near Oslo (Hanekleiva) to make up to 350 EPODs a year.
